C1482.title: Meng Dong and He Likang Q Coin Theft Case
C1482.summary: In July 2005, Meng Dong used a hacking program to obtain credentials for Maoli Company's online top-up system and worked with He Likang to steal and resell Q Coins and game point cards. The Shanghai Huangpu District People's Court found that they had secretly taken online property worth RMB 25,948.96 for illegal possession, convicted both of theft, and imposed corresponding sentences.
